component.name: runs-app
component.description: Running tracker with Garmin FIT import and Strava integration

vulnerabilities.impactStatement: runs-app does not parse untrusted or user-supplied XML. libexpat (the vulnerable component) is an Alpine base image transitive dependency with no execution path in the runs-app attack surface. The application processes Garmin FIT binary files and JSON from REST APIs, not XML.
